headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty showed resilience amid IT and pharma buying, while October GST collections surged.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: FPIs withdrew ₹34,843 crore from Indian equities in October but turned net buyers in the final week.
October gross GST mop-up grew 23% year-on-year to over ₹2.31 lakh crore.
Crude oil prices hovered above $116 per barrel, impacting global market sentiment.
Strong quarterly profit results from oil marketing companies helped lift market sentiment.
whatHappening: Average daily transaction value on the UPI network crossed ₹1 trillion during October.
Hyundai Motor reported its highest-ever sales for October, driven by strong export growth.
State-run refiners IOC, BPCL, and HPCL reported a combined Q2 profit of ₹30,106 crore.
Iran signaled a potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz within two days subject to US accepting demands.
summary: Markets were closed for the weekend following a week of volatile trading in benchmark indices. Key macroeconomic data showed strong momentum with October GST revenue reaching ₹2.31 lakh crore and UPI daily transactions crossing ₹1 trillion. Trading will resume on Monday, November 2 with investors monitoring crude oil prices and global cues.
